description: This file implements the Image_Color class, providing color conversion, mixing, and related utilities for image processing, including methods for color format conversions, color range generation, and color analysis.

classes.name: Image_Color
classes.description: A class for handling color conversions, mixing, and analysis in image processing.

methods.name: mixColors
methods.description: Mixes two colors by averaging their RGB components, optionally web-safe.

methods.name: setWebSafe
methods.description: Sets whether output colors should be limited to web-safe palette.

methods.name: setColors
methods.description: Sets the two colors used for mixing and range calculations.

methods.name: getRange
methods.description: Generates a range of colors between the two set colors, given a number of steps.

methods.name: changeLightness
methods.description: Adjusts the lightness of the two set colors.

methods.name: getTextColor
methods.description: Determines whether black or white text is more readable on a given background color.

methods.name: _setColors
methods.description: Internal method to assign RGB arrays from color inputs.

methods.name: _splitColor
methods.description: Splits a hex color string into an RGB array.

methods.name: rgb2hex
methods.description: Converts an RGB array to a hex color string.

methods.name: hex2rgb
methods.description: Converts a hex color string to an RGB array, including the original hex.

methods.name: hsv2rgb
methods.description: Converts HSV values to an RGB array.

methods.name: hsv2hex
methods.description: Converts HSV values to a hex color string.

methods.name: allocateColor
methods.description: Allocates a color in an image resource based on a color string or array.

methods.name: color2RGB
methods.description: Converts a color name or hex string to an RGB array.

methods.name: namedColor2RGB
methods.description: Converts a named color to an RGB array, defaults to black if unknown.

methods.name: percentageColor2RGB
methods.description: Converts a percentage-based RGB string to an RGB array.
